title: Text: DET Chad Crunk ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I’m not gonna run it up the ladder or anything, just keep it in mind. Today was 21 min and it’s consistently been 15-plus. Know it’s probably tough to get him moving.

Anthony, understand the frustration and apologize that it took so long for the clubhouse to open tonight. Trust me, it frustrates me as well as I know you guys need to get in there and talk to guys before they head out. Will continue to try and make sure it opens in a timely fashion
Thanks. Glad to know it goes both ways. Again, not trying to be a jerk.
Not for use but do you know what they would be thinking if tomorrow gets banged. Not a doubleheader on Sunday, right?
No, I think the make up would be our next trip to Chicago in July
Agreed, think we all need a day off after that game tonight
